note: Entity Reference Tree provides one field widget 'entity_reference_tree' (EntityReferenceTreeWidget, extends EntityReferenceAutocompleteWidget, multiple_values=TRUE) for entity_reference fields, selected on Manage form display. It adds a jsTree modal (checkbox hierarchy + search) beside the autocomplete; tree JSON at /admin/entity_reference_tree/json/{entity_type}/{bundles}; builders are tagged services entity_reference_tree_builder (TaxonomyTreeBuilder, EntityTreeBuilder). Widget settings schema field.widget.settings.entity_reference_tree: theme, dots, worker, disable_animation, force_text, label, dialog_title, placeholder, match_operator, match_limit, size, autocomplete_maxlength. Hook: hook_entity_reference_tree_create_term_node_alter. No configure route/permission/drush. Medium/hard cases create namespaced entity_reference fields (field_ert_*) on node.article and read/set the widget type + settings on the default form display.

evals.prompt: What field widget does the entity_reference_tree module add, which field type does it work on, and where do you switch a field to use it?
evals.expected_output: It adds the 'Entity reference tree widget' (id entity_reference_tree) for entity_reference fields. You select it in the field's Manage form display (the widget column), no separate settings page.

evals.prompt: Name several settings the entity_reference_tree widget exposes (for example the jsTree theme, the button label, the dialog title, autocomplete limits).
evals.expected_output: Settings (field.widget.settings.entity_reference_tree) include theme, dots, worker, disable_animation, force_text, label (button label), dialog_title, placeholder, match_operator, match_limit, size, and autocomplete_maxlength.

evals.prompt: What kind of UI does the entity_reference_tree widget present to editors to select references, and which JavaScript tree library does it use?
evals.expected_output: A button opens a modal dialog containing a jsTree hierarchy with checkboxes and a search box; editors browse/search and tick entities, which fill the autocomplete field. It bundles the jsTree JS library.

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site has an entity reference field named field_ert_known. Inspect the live default form display and state which field widget that field is using.
evals.expected_output: field_ert_known uses the entity_reference_tree widget: in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default its component type is entity_reference_tree.

evals.prompt: On this site an Article entity reference field field_ert_theme uses the Entity Reference Tree widget with a specific jsTree theme configured. Inspect the live form display and report the jsTree theme set for that widget.
evals.expected_output: The widget's theme setting is default-dark: in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_ert_theme component has type entity_reference_tree with settings.theme = default-dark.

evals.prompt: The Article content type has an entity reference field field_ert_task that currently uses the default autocomplete widget on its default form display. Using the entity_reference_tree module, change that field to use the Entity Reference Tree widget, and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the field_ert_task component's widget type to entity_reference_tree in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default (via Manage form display, or $fd->setComponent('field_ert_task', ['type' => 'entity_reference_tree', ...])->save()).

evals.prompt: The Article field field_ert_dialog already uses the Entity Reference Tree widget, but its popup has no custom title. Configure that widget so the tree picker's dialog title reads 'Select items', and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the entity_reference_tree widget's dialog_title setting to 'Select items' for field_ert_dialog in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default (settings.dialog_title = 'Select items').
